headline: Tencent's HY3 hits 16.7% — a new all-time high
summary: Tencent/hy3-20260706 claimed the top spot for the second day running, posting an all-time token-share record of 16.7% and vaulting past DeepSeek's flash variant. DeepSeek still commands 27.0% provider share across its roster, but Tencent's surge—up 4.4 points in a day—marks a genuine inflection. Two new entrants (Mistral AI's nemo and Qwen's qwen3.6-35b) arrived at ranks 43 and 47, while Google's gemini-3.5-flash and OpenAI's gpt-5.4 dropped off entirely.
